reply_text:
Everything from our session in futon3c is committed. The three uncommitted files there belong to other seats, so I'll leave them. The branch is 3 commits ahead of GitHub: two of mine and one other.Still fixing a bracket in the new test, then the practice commit in futon5a.Now futon5a: install the signing hook there, then make the practice commit.Gist: Ready. futon3c is committed and pushed, and futon5a has one signed practice commit, b34a980, which adds `REWIND-PRACTICE.md`. To rewind it: once this turn shows up in the stepper, press `r`, move the cursor onto the futon5a lines, and press `R`. Don't press `R` on the futon3c lines or at the top of the view: this turn also has a signed futon3c commit of mine, 845c2f40, and from those places `R` would revert it too.

**futon3c:** all my work from the session is committed, and master is pushed and level with GitHub. The push also carried one other seat's already-committed commit, 2692222c (mission-control fetch). The three uncommitted files there belong to other seats, so I left them alone.

**futon5a:**
- I installed the signing hook there, which was needed to sign the commit.
- I haven't pushed futon5a: you only asked for a practice commit, and it also has two commits of someone else's ("missions: disposition + acceptance") waiting to go to lucy.
- Its one uncommitted edit, `config/nonstarter-personal.el`, isn't mine, and doesn't block the rewind.

**Two changes to `R` this turn** (845c2f40):
- **Per-repo:** on a repo's lines, `R` acts on that repo only.
- **Uncommitted edits:** it now refuses only when they touch files the revert would change, which is git's own rule. Before, any uncommitted edit anywhere in the checkout would have blocked your practice rewind.

22 stepper tests pass, including one where another seat is mid-edit on an unrelated file.

**Timing:** this frame appears only after 象 has read the turn, a few minutes after this reply ends, provided futon1b isn't timing out again. The stepper retries its reload if it is.
